checks.result: The self-hosted runner's mise-shim race (ETXTBSY, exit 126) is runner-side concurrency, not a branch problem. The repo-side retry for check.yml cannot ship as a PR: the App is refused write access to .github/workflows.
checks.follow_up: A verified one-step diff is in issue #2182. The maintainer closed #2182 on 2026-10-22 and check.yml is unchanged since #2094, so the retry was NOT applied - most likely the runner's job-concurrency was fixed instead. Do not re-raise; the durable fix is outside this repo.

checks.result: Admin sort audit COMPLETE (all thirteen indexes match their labels). NEW finding: the /design-system page's thirteen 'Source' links pointed at '/shared/_button.html.erb' and the header's contracts link at '/specs/.../README.md' - app paths no route serves, so all fourteen 404'd.
checks.follow_up: The link fix is a draft PR (branch repo-assist/fix-design-system-source-links-5e9b3d07). The repo URL and branch now live in config/settings.yml as github_repo_url / github_source_branch.

checks.result: CHANGELOG.md re-synced for the eight PRs merged on 2026-10-22, which the previous sync (#2172, merged 08:02) had missed because they landed at 08:23-08:26. The gap had left a stored-XSS fix and four 500 fixes undocumented. Draft PR on branch repo-assist/docs-changelog-sync-2026-10-22.

checks.result: Integration sessions do NOT persist here: IntegrationTestCase#sign_in sets session[:current_session_id] but the cookie is never written, so the next request is anonymous.
checks.follow_up: So a test asserting 'redirects to root_path' can pass for the wrong reason (authenticate_user! redirects there too). Use ActionController::TestCase with @request.session, and add a happy-path 200 assertion.

checks.result: Stored XSS confirmed and fixed in PR #2176 (MERGED): ActionText sanitizes only via ActionText::ContentHelper, but RichTextRenderService, MarkdownRenderService and RichTextContent#content_body read the raw fragment.
checks.follow_up: config/initializers/content_security_policy.rb is entirely commented out - a CSP header is a natural follow-up. The sanitizer drops inline style attributes and non-Turbo data-* attributes.

checks.result: NOT released. 34 commits unreleased since 2026-09-07, including eight Repo Assist fixes merged on 2026-10-22, a security fix, a major ransack bump and the deliberate json pin.

checks.result: Open Repo Assist drafts: #2186 (admin sort vs column), #2187 (rack-attack throttle test flakiness), plus three new ones - helper test coverage, design-system source links, and the changelog re-sync. #2186 and #2187 are green on Check with no comments or reviews.
checks.follow_up: All the PRs the previous summary listed (#2181, #2184, #2178, #2176, #2172, #2171, #2169, #2163, #2180, #2174, #2167) are MERGED, and every issue it listed is CLOSED. The monthly body was rewritten around that.

checks.result: Full non-system suite on main: 1686 runs, 5385 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skips. With the helper tests: 1714 runs. With the link fix: 1688 runs.
checks.follow_up: Run via ruby -Itest glob loader, NOT `bin/rails test`: the rake path pulls test:prepare -> css:install and aborts without bun. Rack::Attack buckets per Time.now.to_i / period, so a fixed-request-count throttle test is a bucket-boundary flake. New tests were mutation-checked.

checks.result: bin/rubocop 607 files no offenses; bin/rails zeitwerk:check all good; bin/lint-design-system 43 pre-existing DS010 warnings, none blocking, none introduced. safeoutputs update_issue allows only ONE call per run.
checks.follow_up: This run spent that single call on the monthly activity body, so the body was replaced instead of a comment being appended. bun is NOT on PATH by default: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" first.
